title: HVAC Technician
salary_note: No salary given on the careers page — page must say 'Competitive salary'.
experience: Previous experience in air conditioning, HVAC, or a similar technical field
description_text:
Our client is a well-established technical services company operating in Malta, specialising in air conditioning, ventilation systems, and after-sales support services. The company is committed to delivering reliable installation, maintenance, and repair solutions while maintaining high standards of quality and customer satisfaction.
 The Technician is responsible for providing after-sales technical support, including the installation, maintenance, and repair of air conditioning and ventilation systems. The role requires strong hands-on technical ability, attention to detail, and a customer-focused approach.
 Key Responsibilities
 Install, maintain, and repair ventilation and air conditioning systems and equipment.
 Identify and report maintenance risks and technical issues on equipment.
 Clean, adjust, and repair systems, and perform warranty-related services.
 Provide technical guidance and on-the-job support when required.
 Maintain accurate daily logs and records of maintenance activities.
 Ensure compliance with appliance standards and Occupational Health and Safety regulations.
 Follow service standards, work instructions, and customer requirements.
 Assist customers with technical queries and provide professional support.
 Carry out mechanical assembly of products when required.
 Set up and install products at customer premises.
 Support the team in delivering efficient and high-quality service.
 Requirements
 Previous experience in air conditioning, HVAC, or a similar technical field.
 Good knowledge of installation, maintenance, and repair of HVAC systems.
 Ability to communicate in English and Maltese , both written and spoken.
 Basic computer literacy.
 Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
 Good organisational and time management abilities.
 Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
 Strong customer service orientation.
 What We Offer
 Stable full-time employment on an indefinite contract.
 Opportunity to grow within a technical and service-oriented company.
 On-the-job training and skills development.
 Supportive and professional working environment.
 Exposure to a wide range of technical projects and clients.
 Join Our Team
 If you are a hands-on technician with a passion for HVAC systems and customer service, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and become part of a growing technical team dedicated to quality and reliability.
